visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with an animation of a blue cat-like character, Capoo, frantically chopping carrots on a wooden table. Capoo's mouth is wide, tongue out, and sweat beads are flying as it uses a large cleaver to slice carrots at high speed. (2) A green caterpillar-like dog, Dogdog, enters wearing a large clear collar. Capoo looks surprised and excited, dropping the knife. The background is a simple white void with a dark horizontal line representing the table. (3) Capoo begins stuffing the large pile of sliced carrots into Dogdog's collar, treating the dog like a storage container. Dogdog looks happy with its tongue out as the carrots fill its body. (4) The scene changes to a boat on a lake. Capoo is rowing a wooden boat with a heavy oar, sweating and looking exhausted. Dogdog is sitting at the back of the boat, acting as a passenger. (5) Capoo attaches a propeller to Dogdog's tail, turning the dog into an outboard motor. The boat speeds across the blue water, creating white splashes, while Capoo smiles happily with the increased speed. (6) Back indoors, Capoo is resting on a yellow beanbag chair, lazily eating snacks from a silver bowl. Dogdog stands nearby. The environment is clean and white with no other furniture visible. (7) Dogdog uses a fishing rod with a mechanical claw to steal snacks from Capoo's bowl. The claw descends from above, grabs a snack, and pulls it up to Dogdog's mouth while Capoo rests. (8) The claw descends again but grabs the entire silver bowl. It swings the bowl and accidentally slams it into Capoo's face. Capoo's eyes shrink in shock and a red impact mark appears on its head. (9) Capoo is shown crying and screaming in pain with large tears flowing. Dogdog stands next to it holding a first aid kit with a red cross, looking guilty or helpful.
